column1: # SuperView Graphics (SGX/SVG), IFF-RGFX, YAFA, CDXL and Amiga bitmap fonts: RECOIL has none of them.

column4: RECOIL has no Amiga SGX support (it only knows the SymbOS SGX) and rejects the file. Layout per Kleinert's SGX spec v4.2 with the sample-measured offsets (data at 822, 8-bit chunky, 256-entry palette). Output matches testimg-lz77.sgx pixel for pixel, and that file's zlib payload inflates to exactly this file's data. Reviewed: clean photo of orange flowers.
Same picture as testimg.sgx stored as LZ77 (length plus zlib stream); the decoded pixels are identical to the raw file's. RECOIL rejects it. Reviewed: clean photo of orange flowers.

SVG Graphics File with the 8-bit chunky body packed by XPK NUKE; RECOIL rejects it. The unpacked bytes (Ancient 2.x, BSD-2, run as a black box) rendered through the header palette in Python give pixels identical to ours. Reviewed: the SuperView splash screen (red SUPERVIEW lettering, gold spheres on a blue gradient), clean.

SVG Graphics File with a 32-bit RGBA body packed by XPK RLEN; RECOIL rejects it. The unpacked bytes are identical to Ancient 2.x's (black box) and a separate Python RLEN walk; Pillow's alpha_composite over 0xc0c0c0 gives pixels identical to ours. Reviewed: rainbow disc with a cartouche, checker corners transparent.
